svg.aria-label: wireframe schematic — the app’s own layout, drawn frame by frame: the given, then each beat. given a beat whose harvest holds a before/after pair; beat 1: its row renders → the proof cell is already looping — no mode to pick, no play to press — zoomed onto the focus by default, with the whole frame exactly one toggle away; beat 2: the row is the Given → its one frame stays a still: a state, not an action
